summary: Vienna, Austria — August 31, 2026 — Bybit EU, headquartered in Vienna and operating under a MiCAR license granted by Austria’s Financial Market Authority (FMA), has been selected as a recommended alternative for MEXC users based in the Netherlands. This shift follows MEXC’s cessation of operations in the Netherlands in compliance with European regulatory requirements. […]
content: Bybit EU has partnered with MEXC to act as a recommended alternative for users based in the Netherlands. This transition occurs as MEXC ceases its operations in the Dutch market to comply with European regulatory requirements. Bybit EU operates under a MiCAR license granted by Austria's Financial Market Authority and is headquartered in Vienna, facilitating a seamless user migration for affected customers.
